payload.name: Extract Explicit Business or Venture Status
payload.description: When a speaker explicitly states the current condition of their business, store, or venture, extract it as a state memory.
content: During extraction, when a speaker reports the current status of a business, store, or venture they own or run (e.g., 'doing great', 'struggling'), create a state memory with subject=speaker, the named entity, and the stated status.
Set world_start to the message/session date and use only explicit wording; do not infer status from enthusiasm, obstacles, or future plans.
Stop after capturing the stated status; do not add unrelated details from the same message unless they are separate explicit facts.

solves: During memory extraction, explicit statements about the current condition of a person's business, store, or venture are often skipped because existing skills focus on projects, events, and emotional support. This Skill ensures these direct status assertions are captured as durable state memories so future questions about the business can be answered.
